about_the_game:
Panic Sell is a free trading simulator where markets are crazy, coins are jumping, and your choice decides the fate of your virtual wallet. Your motto in this game is: buy low and sell high. Try not to lose all your money, but on the contrary, become very successful.

In this game, you are waiting for 10 coins that change in value randomly. However, Panic Sell has some secrets that will help you increase your chances of successful transactions. Every 20 price marks there is a line that blocks the price from moving into another range with a probability of 70%. And every 60 marks there is a line that blocks 90% of attempts to cross the line. Use these support and resistance lines to win.

You can buy or sell any number of coins if you have enough budget for it. Time is running out and prices are changing every few seconds. Therefore, sometimes it is worth acting quickly, and sometimes it is worth waiting for a more opportune moment. The main objective of the game is to achieve the largest possible total capital.

Learn to catch prices near support and resistance lines in time. Be patient. Observe. Act accurately and quickly. Go ahead!
